functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core.reject_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Immutable prepared record: create a new revision instead' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END $function$
